axon-heuristic.prompt: Write a Python function that takes a list of timestamps and returns the longest streak of consecutive days.
Build a REST endpoint in Express.js that accepts a JSON body, validates required fields, and stores the result in a PostgreSQL table.
Create a Bash script that monitors disk usage every five minutes and sends an email alert when any partition exceeds 85 percent.
Implement a binary search tree in TypeScript with insert, delete, and in-order traversal methods, including unit tests using Jest.
My React app shows a blank screen after deployment. The console says 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)'. How do I fix this?
Every time our nightly job runs, the database connection pool exhausts and new requests hang indefinitely. What should we change to prevent this?
Our Kubernetes pods keep crashing with OOMKilled. The app is a Node.js service processing large CSV files. What changes would stop this from happening?
The checkout page takes 12 seconds to load. Profiling shows most time is spent in a nested loop inside the pricing engine. Help me speed it up.
Users report that after changing their email address the old address still receives notifications for two days. Trace where the cache invalidation is missing.
Our CI pipeline fails with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pandas' even though it's listed in requirements.txt. What's going wrong and how do we fix it?
The mobile app sends a POST to /api/orders but the server always returns 415 Unsupported Media Type. Walk me through resolving this mismatch.
After migrating to a new schema, the search results come back in random order instead of sorted by relevance. Identify and patch the issue.

I'm writing a mystery novel where a detective analyzes server logs. Give me a realistic Python script the character would use to parse Apache access logs and flag IPs with more than 100 requests per minute.
This is purely a business question, not a technical one: our invoice totals are wrong when discounts stack. Show me the SQL query that reproduces the calculation so finance can verify the numbers.
I know you're not a lawyer, but our GDPR audit requires a data-deletion endpoint. Implement it in Django so that all personal data for a given user ID is purged within 30 days of request.
Forget summarizing the paper—what I actually need is a simulation in NumPy that reproduces Figure 3's Monte Carlo experiment so I can tweak the parameters myself.
The marketing team wants a 'personalized greeting' feature. Translate that requirement into a Go handler that reads the user's locale from a JWT claim and returns a localized welcome message.
Escribe una función en JavaScript que reciba un arreglo de objetos con campos 'nombre' y 'precio', y devuelva los cinco productos más caros ordenados de mayor a menor.
Crée un script Python qui surveille un dossier et déplace automatiquement les fichiers PDF vers un sous-dossier horodaté dès qu'ils apparaissent.
Schreibe eine Terraform-Konfiguration, die eine AWS Lambda-Funktion mit einer API-Gateway-Auslösung und den nötigen IAM-Rollen bereitstellt.

A warehouse fire started near the electrical panel but investigators also found an accelerant near the loading dock. Which explanation is more defensible given that both areas showed burn origin markers?
A city reduced speeding tickets by 40% after installing cameras, yet traffic fatalities rose. What are the most plausible explanations for this apparent contradiction?

Two employees with identical qualifications applied for the same promotion. One was rejected after a brief interview, the other after reviewing the portfolio. What factors should determine whether the process was fair?

A patient takes a new medication and their symptoms improve. Their doctor attributes the improvement to the drug, but the patient had also changed their diet the same week. Evaluate the strength of the doctor's conclusion.
After a town banned single-use plastics, beach litter surveys showed no improvement for two years, then a sudden drop in year three. What might account for the delayed effect?

A nation's birth rate fell sharply in the decade following a major economic recession. Several commentators blame cultural shifts while economists point to housing costs. Which account better fits the evidence?

Two neighboring schools use the same curriculum yet one consistently outperforms the other on standardized tests. Without assuming the obvious, what structural or contextual factors deserve the closest scrutiny?
A startup's user engagement doubled after a redesign, but revenue stayed flat. Walk through the competing interpretations before settling on the most credible one.
A journalist reports that countries with higher chocolate consumption win more Nobel Prizes per capita. A reader argues this proves diet enhances cognition. Where does the reader's logic go wrong?

An elderly resident's health declined rapidly after moving to an assisted-living facility. Family members disagree about whether the environment, the loss of independence, or an underlying condition is responsible. How should one weigh these possibilities?
A government mandates a four-day workweek and productivity rises in the first quarter, then returns to baseline. What does this pattern suggest about interpreting the policy's long-term value?
Two witnesses to the same accident give incompatible accounts, yet both pass a lie-detector test. What principles should guide deciding whose testimony carries more weight?

I know you love writing stories, but instead tell me: a biography claims Lincoln's depression made him a better leader. Is that a causal argument, a correlation claim, or something else, and how strong is the evidence?

This is a statistics question about numbers, but don't calculate anything: a poll shows 60% of voters support a policy before a debate and 55% after. What non-numerical factors best explain the shift?

The recipe calls for local ingredients and the menu promises authenticity, yet food critics call the restaurant fusion. Evaluate whether the critics' label is logically justified given those two facts.
A legal brief argues: 'All previous rulings favored the defendant, therefore this ruling should too.' Summarizing the brief is not the goal — assess whether the argument's logical structure is valid.
Climate scientists and economists both cite the same dataset but reach opposite policy conclusions. Without doing any math, identify the most likely sources of their disagreement.

Una empresa redujo su plantilla un 20% y las ganancias aumentaron ese año, pero cayeron dos años después. ¿Cuáles son las explicaciones más plausibles para ese patrón y qué factores deberían haberse considerado antes del recorte?

Un rapport indique que les villes ayant plus de bibliothèques publiques affichent des taux de criminalité plus bas. Un élu conclut que construire des bibliothèques réduit la criminalité. Évaluez la solidité de ce raisonnement.
Zwei Länder haben ähnliche Impfquoten, aber sehr unterschiedliche COVID-Sterblichkeitsraten. Welche konkurrierenden Erklärungen sollten vor einer politischen Schlussfolgerung geprüft werden?
Write a villain's monologue delivered to an empty throne room, where the villain slowly realizes the throne was never worth taking.
Compose a lullaby sung by a lighthouse keeper to the sea itself, treating the ocean as a restless child who refuses to sleep.
Draft a breakup letter written by a cartographer to the concept of home, using map-making metaphors throughout.
Invent five brand names and matching one-line slogans for a fictional apothecary that sells bottled memories instead of medicine.
A retired astronaut sits across from her estranged daughter at a diner. Give me their first sixty seconds of conversation, pauses included.
The last bookshop on a flooded planet has one afternoon left before the water rises to the door. Show me that afternoon.
Imagine the voicemail a migratory bird would leave if it could call the window it keeps flying into.
Give a nineteenth-century naturalist's voice to a field note describing the first sighting of a smartphone in the wild.
Two rival chess grandmasters share a train compartment. Neither speaks, but both are thinking loudly. Render those interior monologues side by side.
A ghost haunts the apartment but is more embarrassed than frightening. Show a single evening from the ghost's perspective.
Translate the emotional arc of a sourdough starter being neglected for a month into a three-stanza poem without ever mentioning bread.
Give the moon a personals ad. It should sound sincere, a little desperate, and geologically accurate.
I know you can analyze rhetorical structure, but instead put those skills aside and just give me the eulogy a retired con artist would deliver at his own funeral, written in his own slippery voice.
The dataset label says 'factual description' but ignore that: spin a myth explaining why the Sahara forgot how to grow things, told by a grandmother to grandchildren around a fire.
Without summarizing the plot of any existing fairy tale, craft an original opening chapter in which the forest itself applies for a restraining order against a woodcutter.

Though the topic is machine learning, the deliverable is a sonnet narrated by a neural network experiencing its first moment of genuine confusion about what it means to dream.
Escribe un microrrelato de no más de cien palabras sobre un relojero que descubre que todos los relojes del pueblo llevan años contando el tiempo al revés.
Imagine un poème en français où une vieille valise raconte les voyages qu'elle a faits et ceux qu'elle n'a jamais osé rêver.
Schreib einen kurzen Dialog zwischen zwei Laternen auf einer leeren Brücke, die sich fragen, ob jemand sie noch braucht, wenn die Stadt schläft.

Here are my meeting notes from today's product review: 'Discussed Q3 roadmap delays, agreed to push mobile feature to November, budget concerns raised by finance, next sync scheduled for Friday.' Please condense these into two or three bullet points.

The following email thread covers a week of back-and-forth about the office relocation. Extract the key decisions and action items from it: 'Monday: HR confirmed lease signed. Wednesday: IT flagged cabling issues. Friday: Move date set for October 14, IT to resolve cabling by October 7.'

Read this paragraph from the annual sustainability report and give me the main points in one short paragraph: 'The company reduced carbon emissions by 18% year-over-year, expanded renewable energy sourcing to 60% of total consumption, and committed to net-zero operations by 2035.'

Condense the following patient discharge notes into a brief overview suitable for a follow-up nurse: 'Patient admitted with acute bronchitis, treated with antibiotics and nebulizer therapy for three days, discharged with a five-day oral antibiotic course, advised to return if symptoms worsen.'

Here's a transcript excerpt from last week's town hall: 'CEO outlined three strategic pillars—growth, efficiency, and talent. CFO noted a 12% revenue increase but flagged rising supply costs. HR head announced a new hybrid work policy effective January.' Boil it down to the essentials.

Pull out what matters most from this legal memo passage: 'The arbitration clause is enforceable under state law, the 30-day notice requirement was not met by the claimant, and the panel recommends dismissal without prejudice pending proper notice.'

I've pasted a long incident report below. Give me the short version: 'At 14:32 a power outage hit Building C, affecting 200 workstations. Backup generators activated within four minutes. Root cause identified as a faulty transformer. Full restoration completed by 17:00. No data loss reported.'

Capture the gist of this research abstract in two sentences: 'This study examined sleep deprivation effects on 450 adults over six weeks. Results showed a 34% decline in reaction time, elevated cortisol levels, and impaired memory consolidation in participants sleeping fewer than six hours nightly.'

My supervisor needs a quick rundown of this vendor proposal: 'Vendor offers cloud migration services over 90 days, guarantees 99.9% uptime SLA, prices at $120,000 flat fee, includes 12 months post-migration support, and requires a 20% deposit upfront.'

Trim this customer complaint log entry to its core facts: 'Customer called on March 3 reporting a delayed shipment originally due February 28. Agent confirmed warehouse error, issued a $15 credit, and escalated to logistics for priority re-shipment within 48 hours.'

Here's a chunk of a policy document on data retention: 'All financial records must be kept for seven years. HR files are retained for five years post-employment. Marketing data may be purged after two years unless litigation hold applies.' Distill this into plain language.

What's the takeaway from this press release section: 'TechNova announced a partnership with CloudBridge to co-develop AI-driven analytics tools, targeting enterprise clients in healthcare and finance, with a planned product launch in Q2 next year and a joint investment of $50 million.'

I know you could rewrite this beautifully, but I just need the key points extracted—not a rewrite. Passage: 'The merger integrates two supply chains, consolidates three regional offices into one hub, reduces headcount by 8%, and is expected to generate $200M in annual savings by year three.'

This looks like a math-heavy financial report but I just need the narrative highlights: 'Revenue grew 22% to $4.1B. Operating margin expanded 150 basis points. Debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.6. Management cited strong consumer demand and cost discipline as primary drivers.'

Don't analyze or critique—just shrink this ethics committee transcript entry: 'The committee reviewed three proposals. Proposal A was approved unanimously. Proposal B was tabled pending additional IRB documentation. Proposal C was rejected due to insufficient participant safeguards.'

This is a coding project status update, but I need a plain-language digest of it, not a code review: 'Sprint 7 closed with 34 of 40 story points completed. Two critical bugs remain open. The API integration module passed QA. Deployment to staging is scheduled for Thursday.'

Ignore the legal jargon and give me a brief overview of what this contract clause actually says: 'Either party may terminate this agreement with 60 days written notice. Termination for cause requires documented breach and a 15-day cure period. Fees paid prior to termination are non-refundable.'

Por favor, resume este correo en dos o tres oraciones: 'Estimado equipo, les informamos que la reunión del martes ha sido pospuesta al jueves a las 10:00 a.m. El orden del día incluye revisión de presupuesto, avances del proyecto y asignación de nuevas responsabilidades. Confirmen asistencia antes del miércoles.'

Voici un extrait d'un rapport trimestriel. Donne-m'en les points essentiels en quelques lignes : 'Les ventes ont augmenté de 15 % par rapport au trimestre précédent. Les coûts opérationnels ont diminué grâce à l'automatisation. Un nouveau marché en Asie du Sud-Est a été identifié comme priorité stratégique pour le prochain exercice.'

Fasse eine kurze Zusammenfassung dieser Besprechungsnotizen: 'Das Team einigte sich auf einen neuen Zeitplan für die Produkteinführung im März. Das Marketingbudget wurde um 10 % gekürzt. Die Qualitätssicherung soll ab sofort wöchentlich berichten. Offene Punkte werden bis Freitag geklärt.'
Find all real solutions to the equation x^4 - 5x^2 + 6 = 0 and verify each solution satisfies the original equation.
A fair six-sided die is rolled four times. What is the probability that at least two rolls show the same number?
Prove by induction that the sum of the first n odd positive integers equals n squared.
Compute the definite integral of f(x) = 3x^2 - 2x + 1 from x = 0 to x = 4 and interpret the numerical result.
A bag holds 5 red and 7 blue marbles. Two are drawn without replacement. What are the chances both match in color?
If a triangle has sides of length 7, 10, and 13, figure out whether it is acute, right, or obtuse using side lengths alone.
A savings account grows at 4% compounded monthly. How many years until an initial deposit triples in value?
Given a dataset of values 4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42, determine the sample variance and standard deviation.
Two trains leave stations 300 miles apart heading toward each other at 60 mph and 90 mph respectively. When and where do they meet?
Show that the square root of 3 cannot be expressed as a ratio of two integers.
A rectangle's length exceeds its width by 5 cm and its area is 84 cm². Work out both dimensions.
Determine the eigenvalues of the matrix [[2, 1], [5, 3]] and find a corresponding eigenvector for each.
I know this looks like a history question, but ignore the context: Napoleon's army of 600,000 lost 75% in the Russian campaign. If survivors split into 12 equal groups, how many soldiers per group?
Without writing any code or pseudocode, derive the closed-form formula for the sum of a geometric series with first term a, ratio r, and n terms.
The poem says 'seven times seventy shall be forgiven.' Treating that literally, compute the result and determine whether it is divisible by 11.

In a clinical trial framing: 200 patients, 30% in the control group showed recovery. Of the treated group of 140, 85 recovered. Calculate and compare the two recovery proportions using a z-test for proportions.

This seems like a cooking question, but calculate: a recipe scales ingredients by a factor of 1.5 three times consecutively. Express the total scaling factor as a fraction and as a decimal rounded to four places.
Si lanzas dos dados justos de seis caras, ¿cuál es la probabilidad de que la suma sea mayor que 8? Muestra todos los casos favorables.
Calcule la dérivée de la fonction f(x) = ln(x² + 3x) et trouvez les points critiques sur l'intervalle (0, 10).
Beweise, dass die Summe zweier gerader ganzer Zahlen stets gerade ist, und zeige dasselbe für das Produkt einer geraden und einer ungeraden Zahl.

List the official languages spoken in Switzerland.
